newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore says not many sold ST shares.
newsitem.headline: Singapore says not many sold ST shares.

text.p: Less than one percent of Singaporeans allocated shares in the government's second block sale of Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (ST) shares had sold the stocks, the government said on Wednesday.
About 14,700 Singaporeans sold their newly allocated ST shares when they were traded for the first time on Tuesday, it said in a statement.
It said the vast majority of people were expected to hold on to their shares, which carry loyalty bonuses in 1997, 1998, 2000 and 2002.

The government's investment arm, Temasek Holdings, announced on Monday it was issuing 804 million shares at a discounted price of Singapore $2.50 each to 1.53 million Singaporeans in the second tranche.
Another five million shares were issued to self-help groups.
Most Singaporeans were allocated between 500 to 700 shares each.
The stock closed on Wednesday at S$3.08 each.
